baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated negations in يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً ... إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse blocks two complementary continuities around the same person: an entrusted charge cannot be sent onward, and the person cannot move back into the nearest belonging-group. Negated ability closes both the outward verbal relay and the inward homeward route.

activation_trace.role: Feasibility and capacity supply the agency whose negation closes the remaining acts.
An entrusted charge carried to another makes the first blocked act a post-self relay rather than generic speech.
The group of nearness and belonging identifies both the human destination and the relation the charge would preserve.
Return to a prior place or state supplies the blocked inward and homeward motion.

changed_reading.before: They cannot make a will or return to their family.
changed_reading.after: Both directions of personal continuity are cut: no entrusted word can be sent forward and no person can move back into the kin circle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier writing of what people advanced and of their remaining traces sets an already-operative record beside the unavailable final charge. The denied bequest becomes not the erasure of continuity, but the loss of a last self-authored intervention in a legacy whose prior effects have already gone forward and remain marked.

activation_trace.role: The connected charge to another supplies the attempted final act of deliberate legacy transmission.
Ordered writing supplies a durable non-oral register against which the unspoken final charge is read.
Advance and forward precedence make earlier actions material already sent ahead before any last bequest.
A lasting sign left by what was supplies the residual legacy that survives without a final instruction.

structural_cues: 36:12 places writing, what was advanced, and traces in one sequence long before 36:50 denies a final transmitted charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an encompassing written record of prior advances and traces, then an unavailable bequest; I infer a contrast between already-accrued legacy and lost last-minute authorship. A live alternative is that record and bequest are separate motifs with no intended contrast.

changed_reading.before: The person simply loses the chance to leave a final instruction.
changed_reading.after: The person loses final editorial control over a legacy, while already-forward deeds and their durable traces remain registered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier destroyed generations do not return to the present people, while the focus people cannot return to their own أهل. Repeated non-return scales one blocked homecoming into a one-way boundary between generations.

activation_trace.role: The nearest group of belonging makes the focus failure specifically relational and domestic.
Homeward return supplies the local movement denied in the focus.
The same return image at generational scale turns the local family separation into a repeated historical boundary.

structural_cues: 36:31 and 36:50 repeat لَا يَرْجِعُونَ while changing the relational endpoint from later people to one's own أهل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same negated return construction at generational and household scales; I infer that the repetition nests personal separation inside historical non-return. A live alternative is ordinary lexical recurrence without deliberate scale transfer.

changed_reading.before: They cannot get back home during the sudden event.
changed_reading.after: Their failed homecoming instantiates the surah's larger one-way severance by which a departed generation no longer re-enters the living kin network.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene supplies people actively disputing when one alarming cry seizes them. Against that live speech, تَوْصِيَة becomes the unrealized conversion of ordinary contested talk into a directed final charge: discourse is present, but it is captured before it can be gathered into transmission.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and executable possibility supply what the sudden seizure removes.
The entrusted charge is the ordered, recipient-directed speech that never emerges from the ongoing dispute.
The alarming cry supplies the single interrupting signal that overtakes human speech.
Grasping and capture make the interruption coercive and immediate rather than a gradual loss of strength.
Contention between opponents supplies speech already in progress at the instant of capture.

structural_cues: 36:49 immediately precedes 36:50 and presents disputation as underway when the single cry takes its participants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active disputation, one alarming cry, seizure, and then negated ability to bequeath; I infer that capture interrupts speech before it can become a directed charge. A live alternative is undifferentiated physical incapacity rather than a specific transition from dispute to testament.

changed_reading.before: A sudden event leaves no time for a will.
changed_reading.after: They are seized mid-dispute: abundant adversarial speech cannot be converted into the one relational utterance that would carry beyond them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied return to the closest belonging-group is followed by compelled emergence from graves, rapid motion toward the Lord, and universal presence. The focus does not describe permanent immobility: it cancels the chosen private destination before a different, public destination is imposed.

activation_trace.role: Kin and household belonging supply the private destination that can no longer be reached.
Return to the former place supplies the voluntary homeward vector that is denied.
Air sent into a thing supplies the external initiating act for the new movement.
The grave supplies the new point of departure, replacing the interrupted ordinary location.
Rapid impulsive movement supplies the compelled outward route that contrasts with failed return.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity supply the collective endpoint that supersedes household reunion.

structural_cues: 36:50 denies motion toward أهل; 36:51 redirects motion from graves toward the Lord; 36:53 ends with everyone made present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed family-return followed by externally initiated grave-exit, rapid directed motion, and collective presence; I infer a destination reassignment from private kin space to public mustering. A live alternative is simple chronological succession without a designed spatial contrast.

changed_reading.before: They are immobilized and never return to their families.
changed_reading.after: Their chosen homeward route is canceled, not all motion: after the interval of death they are driven from graves toward a universal rather than domestic gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later near-isomorphic construction retains inability and non-return but puts forward passage where the focus puts bequest. That substitution activates تَوْصِيَة as proxy motion: a connected charge is something of the person meant to proceed when the person cannot return. In the focus, both proxy-forward transmission and homeward motion fail.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another lets the bequest function as continuity projected across the speaker's interruption.
Return supplies the backward route paired with the blocked transmitted continuation.
The repeated inability frame establishes the later clause as a functional comparator for the focus.
Passage and going through supply the forward-motion slot occupied by bequest in the focus construction.
Repeated non-return closes the backward route in both constructions and makes their middle terms comparable.

structural_cues: 36:50 has فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً ... وَلَا ... يَرْجِعُونَ; 36:67 has فَمَا ٱسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closely parallel inability/non-return frames with تَوْصِيَة and مُضِيًّا in corresponding positions; I infer a functional analogy in which a bequest carries agency forward. A live alternative is a stylistic echo whose substituted terms should not transfer meaning.

changed_reading.before: Bequest and return are simply two unrelated acts prevented by the crisis.
changed_reading.after: Bequest is the person's proxy way of going forward; the verse blocks both that transmitted continuation and the person's own route back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ط ع mapping under focus يَسْتَطِيعُونَ rather than the ordinary ط و ع morphology. It remains anchored through that packet-authorized split mapping and the adjacent cry and blowing, but it must be rendered only as an acoustic undertone, never as a replacement translation or a claim about standard derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus form يَسْتَطِيعُونَ through mapped root root_000706 B005, beside the unmade تَوْصِيَة.

activation_trace.role: A blow and its rising sound supply a form-distant acoustic possibility inside the focus word's split inventory.
The entrusted charge supplies the human message whose voice fails to enter the acoustic sequence.
The high voice immediately before the focus activates the otherwise distant rising-sound branch.
Air sent into a thing supplies the breath-driven signal that follows the silenced human charge.

changed_reading.before: They lack the ability to utter a bequest between two eschatological events.
changed_reading.after: As an acoustic undertone, the raised cry and the later blown signal monopolize the channel: no final human voice rises between them to carry a charge.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns generic lack of time into the capture of live disputational speech before it can become a directed final charge.
The following movement revises non-return as destination reassignment: family homecoming is canceled, then grave-exit and universal presence are imposed.
The close 36:67 echo lets bequest function as proxy forward motion paired against return.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed a two-direction continuity structure: prior traces already go forward, a final charge cannot, homeward return fails, and later compelled motion leads elsewhere. The packet's split س ط ع inventory also preserved a contained acoustic undertone between cry and blowing.
remaining_uncertainties: The legacy-record contrast depends on reading 36:12 against 36:50 rather than as an independent motif.
The proxy-motion model depends on functional transfer across the parallel syntax of 36:50 and 36:67.
The acoustic outlier is deliberately form-distant and should remain subordinate to the ordinary ability reading.
